opening.argument: The presentation ties participation in a paid mining scheme to token submission, future-value promises, and package sales. It instructs viewers to submit tokens for mining, while claiming that one coin could reach 2.50 to 5 euros within a year. Mining is then presented as an argument for selling education packages, with leadership and downlines described as central to success. The appeal is also urgent, insisting that everyone should mine immediately because the price will never be this low again, and it closes with the claim that participants could make an absolute fortune. These features solicit paid participation and recruitment rather than merely explaining cryptocurrency technology.
